name: WF1 - Ingestion PDF KPU per Pasal

parameters.query:
SELECT
    $1::text AS pdf_url,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM ingestion.documents
        WHERE source_url = $1
          AND status = 'success'
    ) AS already_processed;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: 'WF1', execution_id: String($execution.id), status: 'processing', document_id: 'jdih-' + $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.pdf_url.hash('sha256'), source_url: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.pdf_url, document_type: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.document_type ?? null, document_number: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.document_number ?? null, title: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.title ?? null, year: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.year ?? null, file_hash: $json.file_hash, namespace: 'kpu_jdih', pinecone_confirmed: false, retry_error_id: $('Siapkan Dokumen').item.json.retry_error_id ?? null }) }}
